handback.title: A run keeps its work when its branch moved
handback.summary: A run whose branch or logs branch moved while it ran catches up and keeps its work and log.
handback.user_story: A run whose branch moved while it worked still saves its work and log, and names any clashing files.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the run's branch moved during the run, the run's commit still ends on top of it.
acceptance_criteria.words: When a push of the run's branch or of `logs` is rejected because the remote moved, fetch, rebase the run's own commits onto the new tip, and push again (a few tries).

edge_cases.case: The branch moves again while the run catches up.
The planner merged main in at its start; main stays merged once, never copied.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the run's changes clash with the moved branch, the failed run's record names the clashing files.
acceptance_criteria.words: Only if the rebase conflicts does the run fail, and then the record names the conflicting files.

edge_cases.case: Two files clash, and the record names both.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the logs branch moved during the run, the run's conversation log still lands on top of it.
acceptance_criteria.words: When a push of the run's branch or of `logs` is rejected because the remote moved, fetch, rebase the run's own commits onto the new tip, and push again (a few tries).

edge_cases.case: The logs branch moves again while the run catches up.

acceptance_criteria.text: When one of the run's own pushes did not land, the run starts no next agent.
acceptance_criteria.words: The run that dispatches the next agent does so only after its own pushes have landed.

edge_cases.case: Only the conversation log push failed.

answers.why: The checker refuses a plan with no criteria, so the plan stays unbuilt; the owner confirms dropping it.

raises.label: Ask withdrawn
raises.text: You withdrew this ask and closed the issue. Should this plan and its tests be dropped? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: Owner comment of 2026-10-19T14:24:29Z on #912 names #914 as the real fix.

raises.label: Closed issue still runs
raises.text: A closed issue still starts agent runs: plan review and this planner ran after the owner closed it.
